description: This file defines the ModuleActivator interface in the OpenMRS platform, specifying lifecycle methods for module management such as starting, stopping, and context refresh events.

classes.name: ModuleActivator
classes.description: Interface for module lifecycle event callbacks in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Method called before the application context is refreshed, typically when a module is starting or the application is refreshing.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Method called after the application context has been refreshed, indicating modules have been started.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Method called before a module starts, before the service layer is available.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Method called after a module has started and is fully functional.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Method called before a module is stopped.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Method called after a module has been stopped.
